title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a 'deliver fast' mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

description:
Cyrex, a Magic Media company, is a media and tech start-up powered by creativity and innovation. We work with leading developers and publishers in the games industry, providing support and solutions designed around individual needs and carried out by global experts.

We produce high-quality results by constantly staying at the forefront of modern technology and cutting-edge processes and practices. The best of our team are known for their strong initiative, not just in taking care of their day-to-day responsibilities but in helping identify ways to build, grow, and do more in their work.

We’re currently looking for adynamic addition tothe team tohelp work onexciting cybersecurity and development projects for the video games industry. Ifyou’re anenthusiastic, motivated, and lateral thinker, our team iswaiting tomeet you!

Responsibilities

  • Minimal RE capability: read disassembly when needed; use IDA/Ghidra and x64dbg/WinDbg/LLDB to support testing (deep reversing not required).
  • Basic web hacking knowledge.

Working knowledge of

  • Unreal Engine (UE4/UE5, UE4SS), Unity, dnSpy, il2cpp.
  • An opportunity to hone and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of gaming projects
  • The chance to work closely with a team of like-minded creative professionals in a fast-paced, multicultural environment on a variety of gaming projects
  • A competitive salary
  • Ongoing training and professional self-improvement opportunities

If this sounds interesting to you and you’d like to be at the forefront of cybersecurity, we’d love hear from you.

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Computer Scientist - Remote Work
description:
Overview

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley. Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide. When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.

Computer Scientist at BairesDev

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you'll design, optimize, and maintain high-performance data processing systems, focusing on safe concurrency, Python/C++ interoperability, and efficient handling of large-scale datasets. You'll improve pipelines built on Arrow/Parquet, ensure zero-copy and memory-safe operations, and build profiling, debugging, and stress-testing frameworks. The role requires close collaboration with data engineering, DevOps, and platform teams to ensure scalability, stability, and observability across the entire system.

Responsibilities

  • Design and optimize large-scale data processing systems, ensuring safe concurrency, efficient memory usage, and high performance with Python and C++.
  • Improve and integrate pipelines based on columnar formats such as Arrow and Parquet, ensuring zero-copy, type consistency, and optimized I/O performance.
  • Build, profile, and debug critical components using low-level tools such as gdb, valgrind, perf, and sanitizers to detect and resolve race conditions, memory leaks, and performance bottlenecks.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience working with concurrent systems and large-scale data processing.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, including multiprocessing, threading, and shared_memory.
  • Strong experience with modern C++ (C++17+).
  • Advanced knowledge in IPC and shared memory (shm_open, mmap), synchronization and safe concurrency strategies, and Python ↔ C++ interoperability (ctypes, pybind11, numpy.ctypeslib).
  • 3+ years of cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with columnar data and high-performance formats including Apache Arrow, Parquet, and pyarrow/numpy (contiguity, dtypes).
  • Proficient with debugging and profiling tools such as perf, valgrind, gdb/lldb, sanitizers (ASAN/UBSAN), py-spy, and tracemalloc.
  • Strong understanding of memory management, efficiency, zero-copy, and alignment.
  • Experience with stress and integration testing to detect race conditions, memory leaks, and concurrency failures.
  • Experience integrating observability tools such as Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and structured logging.
  • Advanced proficiency in English.

Benefits

  • 100% remote - work from anywhere.
  • Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred.
  • Paid parental leave, vacation, & national holidays.
  • Innovative and multicultural work environment.
  • Collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent in each area.
  • Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.

  • Assegura que todos os procedimentos operacionais usados para Descarga Operacional e Plano de Medição de Gás (como parte da ISO 14001/ISO 50001) sejam seguidos dentro das limitações do processo e alinhados aos objetivos de Produção/Injeção.

  • Facilita e assegura a conformidade com as regulamentações e normas brasileiras de HSE em todas as operações;

  • Participa de exercícios organizados no site pela Companhia e/ou Contratado;
  • Acompanha plano de ações de melhoria após os exercícios;
  • Controla disponibilidade e adequação de equipamentos de resposta a emergências (combate a incêndio, SOPEP etc.) e primeiros socorros.

Auditorias, Inspeções e Revisões

  • Realiza inspeções diárias nas áreas de trabalho, condições e permissões de trabalho;
  • Realiza inspeções nos alojamentos em intervalos regulares;
  • Participa de auditorias programadas e não programadas com a gestão da Companhia, Contratado e outras partes aplicáveis;
  • Lidera e apoia CSR/RSES em auditorias do Sistema de Gestão de HSE/ISO 14001/ISO 50001.

Gestão de Eventos, Melhoria de Performance e Gestão de Dados

  • Reporta desempenho de HSE do Contratado: documenta, acompanha anomalias, quase-acidentes, incidentes e qualquer outro evento de HSE no site conforme requisitos da Companhia;

  • Atua como condutor de análises de causa raiz para Acidentes de alo potencial a bordo do FPSO – monitora os planos de ação;
  • Auxilia o CSR/RSES na condução e gestão dos sistemas de Controle de Risco de Segurança e Meio Ambiente; investiga causas raiz de incidentes e acidentes e define ações corretivas relevantes.

Gestão Social

  • No âmbito do Projeto de Comunicação Social (PCS), monitora, contata por rádio e registra 100% das embarcações não autorizadas que entram na zona de exclusão de 500 m do FPSO.

Profil du candidat

A posição requer um diploma de engenharia de uma universidade reconhecida no Brasil, bem como experiência na indústria de óleo e gás, em uma função de HSE.

  • Habilidade com programas e sistemas MS e aplicações (Synergi, Enablon, HRAF etc.).

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from 'Bronze' (Raw) to 'Silver' (Cleaned) and 'Gold' (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don\u2019t just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Competências Necessárias

A área de engenharia de dados deve garantir que a organização tenha acesso a dados confiáveis e organizados, possibilitando a criação de insights e a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais. Ser um agente de transformação, construindo uma plataforma escalável e resiliente, democratizar o acesso aos dados e impulsionar uma cultura orientada por dados.

Missão da Vaga

Projetar, construir e manter pipelines robustos de dados, garantindo que as informações fluam de maneira eficiente e segura. Garantir a disponibilidade, qualidade e governança dos dados. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders e time visando promover melhores práticas na manipulação, análise de grandes volumes de dados, otimização de processos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis para ingestão, processamento e transformação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para sistemas analíticos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de armazenamento, incluindo data lakes e data warehouses, em ambientes em nuvem.
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração.
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e frameworks modernos.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência com engenharia de dados ou funções similares.
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data viz(tableau, power bi e/ou looker).
  • Histórico de liderança ou participação ativa em projetos complexos de integração e migração para nuvem.
  • Cloud Computing;
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager, DataStream, Vertex AI e GitHub;
  • Experiência em Azure e seus serviços, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Azure Data Lake Storage;
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e Pyspark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados);
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados.
  • Data Lakes: Conhecimento de arquiteturas de Data Lake, armazenamento e otimização de dados (ex.: Delta Lake);
  • DevOps: Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DataOps para automação de deploys e monitoramento de fluxos de dados;
  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/composer para integração e movimentação de dados.
  • Desempenho e Otimização: Experiência em técnicas para melhorar a performance de pipelines de dados e consultas em ambientes distribuídos e não distribuídos.
  • APIs: Conhecimento em extração de dados via APIs RESTful.

Certificações de engenharia de dados nas plataformas GCP e/ou Azure (Professional Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer Associate).

Competências Necessárias Técnicas

  • Capacidade de projetar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e DevOps para integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Forte habilidade de solucionar problemas complexos de dados com eficiência e criatividade.

Competências Necessárias Comportamentais

  • Pensamento analítico e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação para traduzir necessidades técnicas e de negócio.
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência para atender demandas críticas.
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e liderança colaborativa.
  • Compromisso com a aprendizagem contínua e atualização tecnológica.

description:
Job description

A área de engenharia de dados é deve garantir que a organização tenha acesso a dados confiáveis e organizados, possibilitando a criação de insights e a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais. Ser um agente de transformação, construindo uma plataforma escalável e resiliente, democratizar o acesso aos dados e impulsionar uma cultura orientada por dados. Missão da Vaga: Projetar, construir e manter pipelines robustos de dados, garantindo que as informações fluam de maneira eficiente e segura. Garantir a disponibilidade, qualidade e governança dos dados. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders e time visando promover melhores práticas na manipulação, análise de grandes volumes de dados otimização de processos.

Main responsibilities

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis para ingestão, processamento e transformação de grandes volumes de dados. Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para sistemas analíticos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de armazenamento, incluindo data lakes e data warehouses, em ambientes em nuvem.
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração.
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e frameworks modernos.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência com engenharia de dados ou funções similares.
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data viz (tableau, power bi e/ou looker).
  • Histórico de liderança ou participação ativa em projetos complexos de integração e migração para nuvem.
  • Cloud Computing;
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager, DataStream, Vertex AI e GitHub;
  • Experiência em Azure e seus serviços, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Azure Data Lake Storage;
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e Pyspark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados).
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados.
  • Data Lakes: Conhecimento de arquiteturas de Data Lake, armazenamento e otimização de dados (ex.: Delta Lake);
  • DevOps: Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DataOps para automação de deploys e monitoramento de fluxos de dados;
  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/composer para integração e movimentação de dados.
  • Desempenho e Otimização: Experiência em técnicas para melhorar a performance de pipelines de dados e consultas em ambientes distribuídos e não distribuídos.
  • APIs: Conhecimento em extração de dados via APIs RESTful.

Diferenciais: Certificações de engenharia de dados nas plataformas GCP e/ou Azure (Professional Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer Associate).

Competências Necessárias

Técnicas:

  • Capacidade de projetar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e DevOps para integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Forte habilidade de solucionar problemas complexos de dados com eficiência e criatividade.

title: Mecânico Diesel
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando‑se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Mecânico Diesel – Missão

Elaborar planos e executar manutenções

  • Substituir peças, reparar e testar desempenho de componentes e sistema de veículos
  • Efetuar diagnósticos e reparos em conjuntos mecânicos, pneumáticos, hidráulicos e elétricos
  • Realizar serviços de lubrificação dos veículos

Requisitos

  • Ensino Médio Completo.
  • Experiência na função.
  • Informática Básica.
  • Atuação em concessionária e formação em técnica em Mecânica Diesel, Mecatrônica e afins, será um diferencial.

Vantagens/Benefícios

  • Ticket Alimentação (pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família).
  • Assistência Médica (cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama).
  • Assistência Odontológica (cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família).

Job description

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SP vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Profissional responsável por desenvolver intervenções psicomotoras, promovendo o desenvolvimento global da criança, com foco nas funções cognitivas, motoras e emocionais. Atuará de forma integrada à equipe multiprofissional dentro do CEDTEA.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação na área da saúde ou educação;

description:
Descrição da vaga

Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas; Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento).

Quer redirecionar sua carreira profissional, aprender uma nova profissão e iniciar seu próprio negócio? Venha atuar como Corretor de Vida e Previdência na MAG Seguros!

Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores , onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;

Ao conquistar a Habilitação:

  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará, se possuir:

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.

Informações adicionais

PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:

  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão?

Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira.

E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você!

Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula - onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará - com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas - as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira

  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.

Sobre a MAG

Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo.

Hoje, somos a terceira maior seguradora independente do Brasil e contamos com 38 unidades de vendas físicas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que servem de base para o trabalho de mais de seis mil corretores parceiros.

title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator
description:
Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimization by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Planning & Operational Readiness

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.

Operational Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.

We are backed by top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

About The Role

We are looking for a highly technical Paid Search & YouTube Manager who thrives on intent capture, granular data analysis, and scientific rigor. In this role, you will be instrumental in transitioning our SEM and YouTube operations in-house, taking ownership of these critical high-intent channels to help us scale.

You will work directly with the Director of Paid Media to manage, execute, and optimize campaigns primarily on Google (Search & YouTube) and Microsoft (Bing). This role requires an individual who embodies "curiosity"—you never accept "that’s just the way it is" or rely solely on automated bidding strategies without oversight. Instead, you dive deep into the Search Query Reports to understand the "why" behind performance. You will be expected to work transparently, sharing work queues and mid-stream insights to ensure alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Campaign Execution: Take end-to-end ownership of campaign setup, management, and optimization across Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Discovery/Demand Gen) and Microsoft Ads. You will lead the transition of these responsibilities from our current agency partners.

  • Master Intent & Keywords: Meticulously manage keyword strategy. You will move beyond simple broad match reliance to build robust negative keyword lists, structure high-intent ad groups, and maximize Quality Score to improve efficiency.

  • Drive YouTube Performance: Treat YouTube as a direct-response performance channel. You will collaborate with the creative team to iterate on video hooks, pacing, and CTAs based on retention rates and conversion data, not just vanity view metrics.

  • Scientific A/B Testing: Rigorous A/B testing of headlines, descriptions, and extensions, and landing pages.

  • Master Attribution: Utilize internal analytics and multi-touch attribution (MTA) tools alongside platform data to triangulate performance.

  • Analyze & Iterate: Assist in the set-up and evaluation geo holdout tests to prove incrementality.

  • Work Transparently: Maintain visible work queues and rigorous reporting standards. You will prepare data for weekly paid media performance reviews to discuss budget shifts, CPA targets, and anomalies.

Qualifications

  • Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising is non-negotiable. You must have a track record of scaling direct-response accounts in a D2C environment.

  • Demand Gen / YouTube Experience: Proven experience managing YouTube for conversions (VAC/Demand Gen), not just brand awareness. You understand how to buy YouTube traffic that converts.

  • Tech Stack: Proficiency with 1st party analytics tools is essential (GA4, Looker, Tableau or the like). Preferred experience with (or similar tools to) MTA platforms (Northbeam, Triple Whale), and experience implementing tracking pixels (GTM).

  • Resourcefulness: You are scrappy. You use the tools in front of you to prove value and are willing to track down the information you need rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

  • Data-Driven Mindset: You base your decisions on numbers, ROAS/CAC targets, and data, not assumptions.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience in the Health & Wellness, Telehealth, or Biohacking space.
  • Proven success utilizing Google Scripts or automated rules to streamline optimizations.
  • Experience using AI tools (Claude, GoMarble, Gemini) for platform strategy and analysis.

World-Class Benefits

  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies - we manage energy, not time and promote work life flexibility.
  • Exposure to top-tier leadership and a meritocratic culture where the best ideas win regardless of title.
  • Opportunity to work with a high-growth, science-backed brand changing the landscape of performance medicine.

Overview

Fisioterapeuta (Atendimento Humanizado e Padrão Hoteleiro) - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Sobre Nós

Com uma trajetória consolidada de 15 anos de experiência direta (em um grupo com 25 anos de mercado), nossa atuação une o rigor técnico da saúde à excelência do atendimento hoteleiro. Somos referência em cuidados humanizados e de alto padrão. Buscamos profissionais que entendam que cuidar é uma arte que exige técnica, empatia e hospitalidade.

Descrição da Função

Buscamos um(a) Fisioterapeuta para atuação em Rio de Janeiro (RJ), focado(a) no atendimento individualizado e humanizado. O profissional será responsável por:

  • Avaliação e Planejamento Terapêutico: Realizar avaliações funcionais detalhadas e elaborar planos de tratamento fisioterapêutico personalizados, com foco na reabilitação e manutenção da capacidade funcional.
  • Reabilitação e Mobilidade: Aplicar técnicas de fisioterapia motora e respiratória, visando a recuperação da mobilidade, força e independência do assistido.
  • Padrão de Excelência: Integrar o tratamento técnico com a excelência do atendimento hoteleiro, garantindo um ambiente de cuidado seguro, organizado e acolhedor.
  • Monitoramento e Evolução: Monitorar a evolução do quadro clínico, registrando progressos e ajustando o plano terapêutico em colaboração com a equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Ética e Hospitalidade: Zelar pela discrição, ética e conforto do assistido e de sua família, mantendo uma comunicação clara e empática.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Graduação completa em Fisioterapia e registro ativo no CREFITO.
  • Experiência: Experiência comprovada em reabilitação de idosos, pacientes neurológicos ou com necessidades especiais.
  • Diferencial: Experiência prévia em setores de hospitalidade, hotelaria hospitalar, atendimento ao cliente de luxo ou em Fisioterapia Domiciliar (Home Care).
  • Perfil: Postura profissional, pontualidade, excelente comunicação e forte senso de empatia e responsabilidade.
  • Localização: Residir no Rio de Janeiro ou ter fácil acesso.

Nossos Valores

Priorizamos o compromisso, a responsabilidade e, acima de tudo, o respeito humano. Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho profissional para quem deseja crescer com base na excelência e fazer a diferença na vida de nossos assistidos.

Como se Candidatar

Envie seu currículo atualizado e carta de apresentação para (Seu E-mail de Recrutamento) com o assunto: Fisioterapeuta - RJ.

description:

We are seeking an experienced and relationship-driven Customer Success Manager to own the heart of our business: the relationships between physicians and clinicians on the Single Aim platform. This is not a traditional support or ticket-closing role. You will be the face of Single Aim to our providers—acting as a matchmaker, problem solver, and trusted peer to the clinicians we serve.

This role is ideal for someone who speaks the language of healthcare, thrives in ambiguity, and enjoys building processes from scratch in a fast-growing startup environment. Whether you are a former clinician pivoting into tech or a HealthTech operator with strong operational instincts, this is a unique opportunity to shape the future of clinician relationships at Single Aim.

  • Own end-to-end onboarding for physicians, Nurse Practitioners (NPs), and Physician Assistants (PAs), from signup through successful matching.

  • Actively manage strategic matchmaking between physicians and NPs/PAs using high-touch communication (calls, texts, emails).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for larger clients and key physician partners, ensuring trust, satisfaction, and retention.
  • Proactively identify and resolve complex relationship or operational issues before they escalate.
  • Operate comfortably in an evolving admin environment, manually fixing issues and using judgment to keep workflows moving.
  • Work closely with the Founder to translate customer feedback and pain points into product and process improvements.
  • Continuously refine and build scalable customer success processes and best practices.
  • Maintain accurate records of provider interactions, matches, and account status using internal tools, CRMs, and spreadsheets.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Healthcare Customer Success, Provider Relations, or Clinical Operations.
  • OR a clinical background (NP, PA, RN) with a strong desire to move into a full-time operational or business role.
  • Deep familiarity with U.S. healthcare workflows, including credentialing, malpractice, supervision, and scope of practice.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to sound credible and peer-like to clinicians.
  • Highly proactive, outgoing, and comfortable picking up the phone to resolve issues quickly.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, unstructured startup environment.
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using CRMs, spreadsheets, and evolving admin dashboards.

Nice To Have

  • Licensed Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA).
  • Experience working at an early-stage HealthTech startup (Seed to Series B).
  • Prior involvement in building or improving customer success or clinical operations processes.
  • Experience working in remote-first or high-growth startup environments.

Location & Logistics

Location: Fully Remote

Time Zone: U.S. time zones preferred

Type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Salary Range: $3,500 – $4,500/month

Why Join Us?

  • Ownership: You will be the first full-time hire dedicated to Customer Success and will define how this function operates.
  • Impact: Your work directly enables NPs and PAs to start independent practices, expanding healthcare access nationwide.
  • Direct Access: Work closely with the Founder in a flat, high-trust environment.
  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture that values output over hours.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer - São Paulo Based
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a talented SeniorDevSecOps/ Cloud Security Engineer to join our Technology Department, with a focus on strengthening and automating our security posture across cloud and hybrid infrastructure.

As a DevSecOps/Cloud Security Engineer, you will be responsible for embedding security into every stage of our infrastructure lifecycle, from design to deployment. You will lead the implementation of cloud-native security controls in AWS, harden Kubernetes environments, and drive best practices across CI/CD pipelines. Your role includes continuous vulnerability management, network protection, monitoring for threats, and working with development, DevOps and IP teams to ensure secure-by-default practices. You will also proactively identify risks, secure network perimeters, and automate remediation wherever possible.

The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe\'s most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and evolve scalable cloud security controls across AWS multi-account environments using security-as-code principles
  • Own Kubernetes security architecture including workload isolation, RBAC, pod security standards, and network segmentation
  • Embed security automation into CI/CD pipelines, including image scanning, IaC validation, and policy enforcement
  • Continuously assess cloud and Kubernetes environments for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and emerging threats
  • Design and maintain strong IAM and secrets management practices, enforcing least-privilege access
  • Partner with DevOps, Platform, and IP/Network teams to deliver security controls as code and by design
  • Analyze network traffic and security telemetry using flow logs, metrics, and targeted packet inspection where required
  • Ensure alignment with internal security policies and external frameworks (CIS, NIST, ISO 27001, etc.)
  • Produce and maintain clear documentation, including security architectures, runbooks, and incident response playbooks
  • Act as a security champion, driving best practices, awareness, and secure engineering culture across teams

Requirements

  • A minimum of 3+ years in Cloud Security / DevSecOps / Infrastructure Security
  • Strong AWS security fundamentals (IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Config, Security Hub)
  • Solid Linux security and cloud networking fundamentals
  • Hands-on Kubernetes security (RBAC, NetworkPolicies, pod security, image scanning)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Git-based workflows
  • Scripting for automation (Python, Go or Bash)
  • Experience with vulnerability management and container security
  • Security-first mindset with strong troubleshooting skills
  • Experience with WAFs and cloud DDoS protection
  • Comfortable with packet inspection, flow analysis, and traffic monitoring (tcpdump, Wireshark, Suricata, etc.)

Benefits

  • CLT contract — job stability and reliable benefits
  • Quarterly performance bonuses
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin) to kickstart your journey

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver\'s seat for transactions impacting the telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: Collaborate with senior leaders and industry experts
  • Dynamic Work Environment: A fast-paced, innovative workplace where every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Develop your skills in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world
  • Open Communication Culture: An environment where your ideas are heard
  • Get Things Done Attitude: A results-driven team focused on impact

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - LATAM
description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going

Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.

Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.

With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.

If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do

  • Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas through a solid, measurable sales process while conducting detailed and professional sales campaigns;
  • Build a pipeline of new clients through heavy prospecting and networking within the Corporate & FSP sectors;
  • Build and maintain effective client relationships, and strategically navigate to identify and close up & cross-sell expansion business;
  • Develop deep insights regarding customer use cases, internal decision-making nuances, budget cycles, and other key information;
  • Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the value of Magnet Forensics’ portfolio of solutions;
  • Solution Selling by prescribing positive business outcome(s) to the customer’s current business problem(s);
  • Facilitate technical product demonstrations alongside a team of supporting Solution Consultants and manage product trial lifecycle;
  • Expand new and mature existing channel partner relationships to extend reach and accelerate new business growth;
  • Accurately forecast the state of the region weekly, fully leverage Magnet’s complete Sales tech stack, and maintain complete and accurate records of all sales activities in Magnet’s systems.
  • *Note: Travel is a part of this role and could be expected up to 30% of the time.
  • *Preferred location: Brazil (Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro); Mexico City

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience selling software in a fast-paced, competitive market;
  • A track record of consistent quota achievement and ability to deliver consistently against targets – in both direct and channel capacities;
  • The ability to expand the scope of an opportunity at a strategic and tactical level, and utilize appropriate resources to execute successfully;
  • Great understanding of a complex sales process, buying process, and business drivers for enterprise clients;
  • Technical aptitude and ability to learn new business and technical concepts quickly.
  • Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English

Nice To Have Skills

  • Sales background in DFIR (Digital Forensics) and/or Cybersecurity arena;

Indicators of Success

We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have ‘been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us.

How We Work

At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.

We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!

The Most Important Thing

We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:

CARE

We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.

OWN

We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.

DEDICATE

We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.

EVOLVE

We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.

Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator
description:
Description

Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"), hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

THE POSITION

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimisation by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Planning & Operational Readiness
  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.
  • Operational Coordination & Delivery
  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.
  • Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure
  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.
  • Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution
  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.
  • Team & Contractor Coordination
  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
  • Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
  • Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
  • Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure event environments.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
  • Good reporting and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
  • Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Analista de Marketing Direto
description:
Overview

1. COMO É SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA DE MARKETING DIRETO EM MSF-BRASIL?

Você irá desenvolver, implementar e analisar ações de marketing direto, com ênfase em canais offline como malas diretas e cartas de relacionamento, visando fortalecer o vínculo com a base de pessoas doadoras, ampliar a captação de recursos e potencializar o engajamento e a retenção.

Além disso, irá atuar com inovação nas abordagens, otimizando as ações de relacionamento e maximização dos resultados, acompanhando o desempenho das campanhas, identificando oportunidades de melhorias e novos formatos. Além disso, atuar para que todas as ações e materiais de marketing direto reflitam práticas de diversidade, equidade e inclusão, utilizando linguagem acolhedora, acessível e representativa, considerando diferentes perfis da base de pessoas doadoras.

Desafios

2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?

  • Contribuir para a sustentabilidade e o crescimento da rentabilidade do canal offline, buscando a máxima de resultados e eficiência em custos de produção e logística postal;
  • Evoluir o modelo de marketing direto offline, incorporando análises mais profundas de dados e maior integração com estratégias de canais digitais;
  • Contribuir para uma cultura de análise e otimização contínua, orientando as ações baseadas em dados e subsidiando decisões.

Dia a dia

3. COMO É O DIA DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

Atividades de Marketing e Relacionamento

  • Planejar, implementar e otimizar campanhas de marketing direto offline (malas, cartas e materiais impressos), contribuindo com a Coordenação desde a construção até a mensuração dos resultados;
  • Executar segmentações e propor novos critérios e testes A/B, documentando aprendizados hipóteses resultados e fluxos;
  • Supervisionar o fluxo de produção com pessoas fornecedoras internas e externas de mala direta e materiais institucionais, assegurando prazos, qualidade e respeitando orçamento e custos finais de acordo com a verba disponível;
  • Acompanhar e realizar análise de resultados de campanhas, elaborando relatórios e propondo melhorias com base em métricas, como taxa de resposta, custo por aquisição, valor médio de doação e taxa de retenção;
  • Contribuir para que as peças, textos e segmentações adotem linguagem inclusiva, evitando vieses ou estereótipos e assegurando que diferentes perfis de pessoas doadoras se sintam respeitados e representados;
  • Acompanhar tendências e benchmarks de mercado em marketing direto e relacionamento com pessoas doadoras, aplicando boas práticas e sugerindo melhorias;
  • Considerar acessibilidade e inclusão nas propostas e revisões de materiais impressos e digitais, identificando ajustes que tornem a comunicação mais clara e inclusiva;
  • Contribuir ativamente para o planejamento anual de marketing direto, identificando oportunidades de inovação, otimização de processos e aumento de eficiência;
  • Contribuir para a integração das ações de marketing direto com campanhas digitais, fortalecendo a jornada multicanal da pessoa doadora;
  • Adotar metodologias ágeis, trabalhando em ciclos curtos de entrega, aprendizado contínuo e adaptação às mudanças;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as demais células do Hub, assegurando coesão das estratégias de relacionamento e desenvolvimento, de acordo com os objetivos estratégicos de cada área;

Compromissos Institucionais – MSF-Brasil

  • Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores e princípios da organização, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho ético, equitativo e inclusivo, pautado pela escuta ativa, pelo respeito e pela colaboração;
  • Conhecer e aplicar as diretrizes éticas de MSF-Brasil e os Compromissos Comportamentais da organização no exercício de suas atividades, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, transparente e coerente com os princípios institucionais;
  • Colaborar com outras áreas e equipes de forma proativa, contribuindo para o fortalecimento do trabalho transversal e para a melhoria contínua de processos;
  • Contribuir, dentro de suas atribuições, para a implementação dos objetivos definidos nos planejamentos estratégico e operacional, com responsabilidade sobre suas entregas e atenção à qualidade do trabalho;
  • Adotar práticas que valorizem a diversidade, a equidade e a inclusão, respeitando diferentes perspectivas, combatendo qualquer forma de discriminação e contribuindo para um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas.

Requisitos

4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

  • Graduação completa em Marketing e áreas afins
  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes/pessoas doadoras ou comunicação (campanhas offline)
  • Proficiência intermediária em Inglês
  • Conhecimentos de Pacote office e CRM
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de BI, relatórios de performance e análise de resultados
  • Conhecimentos de diversidade, equidade e inclusão em campanhas

Competências

We are looking for a proactive Sales Support Specialist to join our team in Rio de Janeiro.

Welltec is a fast-growing, global technology company that develops and provides efficient, hi-tech solutions for the energy industry. We are looking for a colleague who wants to be part of a small, informal team, who is always ready to help each other. It is also important that you like working in an environment where things are constantly changing. In addition, you must have:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience from a similar position.
  • Professional in English.

And finally, you must be:

  • Service minded.
  • Curious and structured.
  • Proactive and good at following up.

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting, rewarding and a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunities employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate.

Also, Welltec® offers a competitive compensation package, health and dental insurance, Wellhub, Prived Pension and life insurance.

The process

If you are interested and feel you match the qualifications for this position submit your resume and application.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. When you apply, please specify which of our locations that you apply for. You can apply for multiple locations.

title: Onboarding Manager (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , MonetizeMore focuses on proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals. You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts—you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. 2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher\'s specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. 3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-to-day Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don\'t just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers\' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves:

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have:

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.
